eyebrow.note: h2.eyebrow.u-mb-0.u-text-center — computes weight 400 because .u-mb-0 declares font-weight:400 and wins. Correct, not a bug.

logoCount.note: A COUNT ONLY. There is deliberately no logo-file field. The four real marks are third-party trademarks under assetRole press.logo, pinned to must-not-reproduce-real-mark — a generator has nothing here to populate with a mark.

constraints.licensing: press.logo is pinned to must-not-reproduce-real-mark. See assets/asset-roles.json.

motion.note: No entrance or scroll animation. CSS hover transitions on .btn (colour trio, 300ms ease.outQuart) are global chrome behaviour, not section motion.

responsive.desktop: peach bar, radius 40px, padding 56px 43.2px, gap 32px, eyebrow left and a 70%-wide / max 750px logo row with space-between.
responsive.le991: flex-direction column, padding 32px, logo row 100% wide and centred with 32px gap.
responsive.le479: bar gap 48px; the logo row becomes a single stacked column.
